answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit at a reputation vertex: a graph node vouched for by several long-lived, independently verified peers. A violet badge marks verified nodes, while a public lantern registry publishes their audit trail. Creating fake identities means funding each vertex separately, passing repeated human-linked attestations, and risking the slashing of every deposit if one puppet is caught, so mass sybil creation becomes expensive and detectable instead of free.
